results.note: Test asserts every golden's `source` field is a non-empty string; tests/goldens/btc_daily_close.json:13 carries a real provenance string naming the published OKX 1Dutc candle reference used for hand/external computation, not hand arithmetic performed by the code under test.

Test computes the set of indicator families present vs. the set of families with at least one golden marked external:true, and asserts equality — an unmarked golden would leave its family out of external_families and fail the assert. tests/goldens/btc_daily_close.json:12 sets external:true.

assert_matches_golden (line 33) uses plain `==` float equality against golden['expected'], not pytest.approx; the parametrized test at line 58-67 runs this for every golden file against ingest/compute.py's real compute_indicator + daily_close.

Test snapshots the golden file's bytes, forces a mismatch (calculation+1.0), asserts the comparison raises AssertionError, then re-reads the file and asserts its bytes are unchanged. A repo-wide grep for 'golden' (case-insensitive) turns up no regenerate/update-golden script anywhere — only this test file and PRD/docs — confirming there is no code path that writes goldens on run.

Declared gate 'uv run pytest tests/test_goldens.py -q --no-header -o addopts= --tb=short' exits 0, and the four tests in the file (verified by reading the source) are genuine assertion-bearing tests exercising the real ingest/compute.py and ingest/registry.py, not stubs.
